why: Each row has three hair styles (1, 2 and 3 strands), three poses (arms to the right, arms to the left, standing straight) and three feet types (circles, squares, no feet). Row 3 already has 3 strands with arms to the left and no feet, and 1 strand standing with circles, so the missing man must have 2 strands, arms to the right and square feet. Option 1 matches all three. Option 2 has squares and 2 strands but its arms point to the left.
trick: In a 3x3 grid of people, check hair, pose and feet one by one; each one usually appears once in every row.
note: Arms-left pose drawn as an exact mirror of the arms-right pose.
